howto.when: 当您请求创建 ASP.NET Minimal API 端点，或要求为 API 添加 OpenAPI 文档时触发。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, when you ask to create a web API endpoint, Claude will generate ASP.NET Minimal API code with OpenAPI documentation, including request/response models and routing organization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request to create an ASP.NET Minimal API endpoint or ask to add OpenAPI documentation to an API.

say_en.text: Create an ASP.NET Minimal API endpoint
say_en.note: Claude generates endpoint code and OpenAPI docs.

say_en.text: Add operation summary and parameter descriptions to this API
say_en.note: Claude adds WithName and Description attributes.
Claude uses MapGroup to group endpoints.
